title: PROOF These 5 Stocks Will Make Millionaires
creator: Joseph Hogue, CFA
summary: Joseph Hogue updates his five favorite growth themes and the one stock he is buying in each, with over $1.3 million invested across the five, arguing the Nasdaq's 17% fall from its high and the worst November since 2008 is a chance to buy long-term trends at a discount. (1) Fintech: SoFi (SOFI), BUY with a $19.50 target at 2x book value - revenue up 44% to $1.4B, guidance raised to $5B for the year and $6.4B for 2027, members up 37%, charge-offs falling as rates rise, trading at 1.4x book versus 3-4x last year. (2) AI-driven cybersecurity: Fortinet (FTNT), BUY with a $160 fair value - 20% revenue growth, 33% operating profitability, $2.8B free cash flow; he holds 500 shares at $88, up 48%, and also likes Palo Alto, CrowdStrike, Zscaler and Okta. (3) Agentic AI software: ServiceNow (NOW), BUY with a $125 fair value - subscription revenue up 21% to $4B, backlog up 20% to $13.6B; he holds 700 shares at $112 and plans to add 300 more. (4) Open-source AI: Alibaba (BABA), BUY with a ~$135 fair value - Qwen holds 52% of Hugging Face model downloads, cloud revenue up 53%; he holds about 2,000 shares at ~$99, down ~19%, and will add more. (5) Tokenization: Ethereum (ETH), BUY with a base case of $10,000 by 2030 (low case $4,900) - Citi sees tokenized assets growing from $17B to $5.5T by 2030; he holds about $950k in ETHA and Grayscale ETH plus ETH directly. A mid-video Gamma sponsorship break interrupts the list. Some figures are garbled in the auto-captions.

calls.video_title: PROOF These 5 Stocks Will Make Millionaires
calls.thesis: Revenue +44% to $1.4B last quarter, full-year guidance raised to $5B, 2027 guide $6.4B revenue / $0.90 EPS; members +37%, net charge-offs falling even as rates rise, net interest margin expanding; trades at 1.4x book vs 3-4x last year.
calls.base_case: Fintech revenue grew 21% vs 6% for traditional financial services; cross-selling across products keeps growing book value and fair value.
calls.bull_case: Becomes a major bank riding the broader fintech growth story; target goes well beyond $19.50 over the next few years.
calls.bear_case: Higher rates could lift charge-offs; still trades at a premium price-to-book vs legacy banks.

calls.video_title: PROOF These 5 Stocks Will Make Millionaires
calls.thesis: Favorite cybersecurity name for balance of growth and profitability: revenue +20%, operating profitability 33% (best among pure-play cyber), $2.8B free cash flow, product revenue +37% last quarter. Holds 500 shares at $88 cost, +48% so far.
calls.base_case: Gartner expects AI-driven cybersecurity spending +68% to $86B in 2027; enterprise cyber budgets cannot be cut (average hack costs $5M+).
calls.bull_case: Multiple re-rates to 45x P/E on $3.56 EPS -> $160 fair value as the market reprices cybersecurity on higher demand.
calls.bear_case: All cyber names trade steep P/E and P/S; software stocks shunned on fears AI/vibe coding replaces software services.

calls.video_title: PROOF These 5 Stocks Will Make Millionaires
calls.thesis: Agentic orchestration pick: subscription revenue +21% to $4B, remaining performance obligations +20% to $13.6B; new orchestration platform sits between enterprise agents and AI models. Holds 700 shares at $112, plans to add 300 more on weakness.
calls.base_case: Enterprise AI spending +63% to $64B, much of it to software vendors that manage where and how AI is used; demand for orchestration sustains revenue growth.
calls.bull_case: Investors return to software names and pay 8x sales on $16.2B revenue -> $130B market cap / $125 per share.
calls.bear_case: Roughly 20% of enterprise SaaS spend is at risk from AI/vibe coding; trades at 5.9x sales vs double-digit historically, so a re-rate is not guaranteed.

calls.video_title: PROOF These 5 Stocks Will Make Millionaires
calls.thesis: Qwen is the most widely used open AI model (52% of Hugging Face downloads vs 7% each for Google and OpenAI); cloud/compute revenue +53%, AI labs/apps +51%; e-commerce reaches 1.3B consumers with >50% China share. Holds ~2,000 shares at ~$99, down ~19%, will add more and dollar-cost average lower.
calls.base_case: AI segments accelerate overall growth beyond ~10%; at the 5-year average 20x P/E on $6.52 EPS, fair value ~$135.
calls.bull_case: Surprise growth from AI segments drives earnings well above estimates over the next few years.
calls.bear_case: Chinese-company discount persists; overall revenue growth lags at under 10% a year.

calls.video_title: PROOF These 5 Stocks Will Make Millionaires
calls.stated_price: Base case $10,000 per ETH by 2030; low case $4,900
calls.thesis: Tokenization of real-world assets is his most confident trend through 2030 after cybersecurity: Citi base case $5.5T in tokenized assets by 2030 (bear case $2.7T) from $17B today; ETH is the token of choice with >33% of tokenized assets on its network. Holds ~$950k in ETHA and Grayscale ETH plus ETH directly, and sells call options against the ETFs.
calls.base_case: Citi $5.5T tokenized assets by 2030 at ~40% ETH share plus ~$950B stablecoins -> ~$10,000 per ETH, a 474% return from current price.
calls.bull_case: Boston Consulting Group forecasts $14T tokenized by 2030 and $55T by 2035.
calls.bear_case: No direct one-to-one link between tokenization usage and ETH price, so the target is a rough estimate; crypto-skeptic view that this is just crypto-bro dreaming.
